integrity: The exact face census, fundamental-group presentation map, group order, all 231 loop images, their orders, and their conjugacy relation are replayed from embedded finite data. Faithfulness uses the independently published identification of the Poincaré-sphere fundamental group as the binary icosahedral group of order 120.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the standard sixteen-vertex triangulation and to simple combinatorial edge loops. It does not classify longer simple-loop conjugacy types, arbitrary loops, or geometric metric systoles.
title: All 231 triangular systoles share one free-homotopy type in the sixteen-vertex Poincaré sphere
